headerDisplay: Exposes pollen levels from the Google Pollen API as HomeKit air quality sensors

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: For Google API key instructions, see the [README](https://github.com/pburtchaell/homebridge-pollen#readme).

location.title: Location
location.description: Zip code or place name to fetch pollen data for. Geocoded to coordinates on first startup.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: How often to fetch pollen data. Minimum 15 minutes. Free tier allows 5,000 calls/month.

enableCategorySensors.title: Enable Per-Category Sensors
enableCategorySensors.description: Add 3 additional air quality sensors for Tree, Grass and Weed pollen.
